simple.meaning: עֶשֶׂר (ʻeser) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 177 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 5:14. Its contexts include family, death, kingship, city, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֶשֶׂר (H6235).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
